svg.aria-label: claude-infrastructure — the Claude Code creature walking a looping landscape under drifting clouds
svg.title: claude-infrastructure
svg.desc: Dusk Line. Cinematic: a warm horizon burns under a cold upper sky, clouds catch the last light on their undersides, and the creature walks a rim-lit ridge. One 240-second loop; the wordmark is legible at every instant and nothing passes behind it.
